name: one arm pull-up negative
description: A slow lowering from the top of a pull-up using one arm only. It builds one-arm strength through the whole range.
instructions: Pull up or step up so your chin is over the bar using both hands.
Let go with one hand and hold your chin above the bar.
Lower yourself as slowly as you can with one arm.
Keep your shoulder pulled down and your body from spinning.
Reach straight arms, then reset and switch arms.
